role: The element's ARIA role, defining its purpose for assistive technologies.
innerhtml: The element's content, set as raw HTML.
radiogroup: The radio group a command of type radio belongs to.
about: RDFa: the resource the metadata is about.
datatype: RDFa: the datatype of the property's value.
inlist: RDFa: marks the property value as a member of a list.
prefix: RDFa: prefix mappings for CURIE terms.
property: RDFa: the property relating the subject to the value.
resource: RDFa: the resource the property refers to.
typeof: RDFa: the RDF types of the subject.
vocab: RDFa: the default vocabulary for property and typeof terms.
autosave: Non-standard Safari attribute persisting a search field's value across page loads.
results: Non-standard Safari attribute limiting the number of recent-search entries shown in a search field.
security: Non-standard legacy attribute (Internet Explorer) controlling script security in a frame.
unselectable: Non-standard legacy attribute (Internet Explorer/Opera) preventing text selection.
autocomplete: Controls the browser's autofill behavior for the field.
indeterminate: Sets the checkbox's indeterminate visual state.
dirname: Submits the element's text directionality with the form data.
step: The stepping interval for numeric and date-time values.
capture: Requests media capture (camera/microphone) for file uploads.
list: The id of a datalist element providing predefined options.
pattern: A regular expression the value must match to be valid.
name: The name of the control, submitted with the form data.
input.type: The type of control to render.
button.type: The button's behavior type (button, submit or reset).
